title: Google Commits $5 Mn To Sundar Pichai’s Alma Mater IIT Kharagpur
summary: Google announced a commitment of  $5 Mn in funding to IIT Kharagpur, the alma mater of CEO Sundar Pichai, to…
llm_summary: Google is pledging $5 million to the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, the university where CEO Sundar Pichai earned his engineering degree. The funding will support new research labs and talent‑development programs focused on emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and quantum computing
